title: In situ Ge/Zn2GeO4 heterojunctions coupled with a rigid–flexible TiO2/NC dual coating for high-performance lithium-ion battery anodes
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SE00279J, Paper
Kun Peng, Qiushi Huang, Xintong Xu, Rujia Zou
We successfully synthesized a Ge/Zn2GeO4@TiO2@NC composite anode to enhance electrochemical performance by addressing volume expansion, low conductivity, and sluggish kinetics in lithium-ion batteries.
